title: Concept: Multipart Content-Type omits the boundary parameter
description: A multipart Content-Type without a boundary cannot be parsed as declared, so the receiver guesses or rejects the body instead of reading the parts the sender wrote.
applicability: Responses that send a multipart Content-Type.
risk: A client that guesses the boundary can be steered into reading attacker-chosen part boundaries, and a strict client refuses the response; LOW because the affected content is multipart bodies rather than scripts.
